name: Cloak of the Drifter
body:
Price 22,500 gp; Slot shoulders; CL 12th; Weight 1 lb.; Aura strong illusion

DESCRIPTION

This hooded and unassuming brown cloak appears mundane, common, and slightly travelled. With the cloak’s hood pulled over their head, the wearer’s voice, mannerisms, and features become more generalized and ambiguous by the surrounding population’s standards. In this form, the wearer gains a +10 bonus on Disguise checks as long as the disguise is nonspecific. This bonus does not stack with any effects that alter physical appearance. Anyone viewing the wearer with the hood up cannot gain any Perception check bonus from familiarity to see through the disguise. Additionally, the wears gains a +10 bonus on Stealth checks made while hiding in a crowd.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 11,250 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells alter self
